title: Floral carpet (dark blue ground)
notes: Floral carpet (dark blue ground). Harshang pattern, early 19th century, Azerbaijan. Türk ve İslam Eserleri Museum , Istanbul. Acquired 1915. inv. no 735 (3135) from a Mosque in a distric of Armutlu, near Bursa. 245 x 506 cm. published Serare Yetkin's "Early Caucasian carpets in Turkey", plate 93.
